title: Design: Not Tracked replaces the stock line in a part lookup
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an untracked part, part A, with stock in one bin, and a tracked part, part B, with stock.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Create an open work order for this test, work order 1, with one line.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 6.1 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Work Orders page.
custom_steps:
1. Click work order 1.
  2. Click Add Part in the Parts row of its line.
  3. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Part Number box.
  4. Click the X at the top right of the New Part Request window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 2:

  • The New Part Request window opens.

Step 3:

  • Part B's result shows "Inventory Qty:" with its quantity on its second line.
  • Part A's result shows "Not Tracked" on its second line in that place, and its bin chip still shows under it.

Step 4:

  • The window closes and the line's Parts row still shows only Add Part: no part was added.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S9-R21: “In the part lookup on work orders, estimates, part sales and purchase orders, an untracked part shows "Not Tracked" in place of "Inventory Qty: {n}". Its bin chips stay as a shelf reference.”
